Initialization sets both to zero, a walking stop advances both, and camp rest advances elapsed while movement stays fixed. Its selected binder turns an unbound marker into a journey-camp departure/movement string and compares it again at submission. StrategicPlaceId::JourneyCamp carries the same bound camp referent when checked party admission holds, but its codec also carries party identity and is not byte-interchangeable with the trial marker. assessments.assessment: A selected resident draft can pass age 15 and no initial minute to NPC construction. The cached age is 15 and the signed birth is anchored at zero, while the initial personal clock is set to the official minute. If that minute is at least one 365-day year after zero and no intervening operation settles age, effective age is at least 16 while cached age remains 15. The selected NPC policy applies effective age to schedule but cached age to housing and, after a presence gate, romance, before advancing cohort clocks; daily phase receipts can retain a decision. This is a source-conditional sequence.
